name: Keeper of the Siren Song
source:
You were never supposed to be the Keeper of the Siren Song, but now that you’ve snuck into the Trial and deceived everyone, can you convince one of the mer princes to fall in love with you?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你本来不应该成为海妖之歌的守护者，但现在你已经潜入试炼并欺骗了所有人，你能说服其中一位人鱼王子爱上你吗？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
